name: Kiryuu Sarasa
source:
Interests: embroidery
Skills: tailoring
Favorite food: rice

Compared to other girls her age, she emits a mature and calm atmosphere, and she is not easily shaken. She is an ojou-sama that comes from a family with an ancient history. Because of her family background and her qualities, she is very popular among the boys. To date she has rejected countless number of boys.
